label: Basic
description: Basic tabs. Best for the smallest setup: 2 tabs on a muted track switching between an account card and a password card.

label: Line Variant
description: Tabs with the line style. Best for an underlined row stretched full width over 3 cards for account, password and preference forms.

label: Vertical
description: Vertical tabs. Best for a muted column of 3 tabs on the left, with the matching card beside it.

label: Vertical Line
description: Vertical tabs in the line style. Best for a column where a bar on its end edge marks the open section, beside wider cards.

label: Icons
description: Tabs with icons. Best for user, lock and gear icons ahead of each label on a muted track sized to its content.

label: Full Width Icons
description: Full width tabs with icons. Best for a full width track of Overview, Analytics and Settings with icons, over one line placeholder cards.

label: Badge Counts
description: Tabs with counts. Best for mail folders on an underlined row, with tinted counts on Inbox, Drafts and Spam and none on Sent.

label: Side List Icons
description: Side list with icons and counts. Best for a side list of Projects, Tasks, Team and Reports, each led by an icon, 2 ending in a count.

label: Segmented Control
description: Segmented control. Best for a controlled Daily to Yearly switch kept in state, each choice showing one large visitor total.
